clock_rules: survey_release_date denotes questionnaire distribution in these inspected files, not public result/data release.
Keep requested response deadline, reported received-by date, FOMC meeting, minutes release, result PDF availability, XLSX availability and receipt separately.
Exact original NY Fed result timestamps remain null. A minutes-release clock cannot fill that null.
The October 10, 2024 XLSX/Combined backfill does not establish spreadsheet/Combined availability in 2023.
Postmeeting response updates require their own phase and cannot enter a premeeting information set.
identity_rules: Retain instrument SPD/SMP/SME and raw panel label; December2024 Combined/SMP/SPD differ from September2026 Combined/Dealer/Participant labels.
A display-label crosswalk does not make the changing, expanded panel a fixed respondent panel.
Retain exact question and value tags, target definition, horizon, scenario, aggregation and source hash; question numbers alone are not persistent identifiers.
The column spd_question_number persists in SME files; its name does not classify all records as dealer responses.
Legacy spd_question_number can supply canonical SPD numbering rather than the native SMP question number; retain native questionnaire mappings separately.
These files contain cohort aggregate statistics rather than individual respondent microdata.

unit_rules.default: UNVERIFIED: reject automatic numeric conversion until the cycle/question/subject/mode/statistic is mapped against questionnaire and results.
unit_rules.verified_examples_only: The two examples below use decimal fractions for rates and identity for their matched response counts.
unit_rules.heterogeneous_column: aggregation_value also carries monetary amounts, percentage-point changes, basis-point changes, probabilities and date strings. General cell formatting is not a units dictionary.
unit_rules.missingness: Preserve blank cells as null with reason unknown. Do not infer zeros, confidentiality thresholds or equal respondent counts.
unit_rules.distribution_semantics: Cross-respondent quartiles of modal points describe disagreement; averaged respondent bin probabilities describe an aggregate elicited distribution. Neither is an individual-level distribution or market price.

examples.interpretation: Median across Combined respondents of their modal expectations for the median federal-funds projection in the forthcoming FOMC SEP; a second-order expectation.
examples.target_definition: Year-end 2027 median federal-funds-rate projection in the September 2026 SEP, as expected by respondents; distinct from their own policy path.
examples.public_results_timestamp_status: Not authenticated; questionnaire dates and FOMC minutes clocks are not substitutes.
examples.transformation: Decimal(raw_token) * 100, only for this verified field definition.
examples.count_transform: Identity; never apply the rate conversion to counts.
examples.historical_premeeting_public_use: Fails availability gate: answers were collected before the meeting but results were published afterward.

examples.interpretation: Median across Combined respondents of their own modal core-PCE inflation forecasts.
examples.target_definition: 2026 core PCE inflation, fourth quarter over fourth quarter; distinct from monthly CPI and quarterly annualized PCE.
examples.public_results_timestamp_status: Not authenticated; questionnaire dates and FOMC minutes clocks are not substitutes.
examples.transformation: Decimal(raw_token) * 100, only for this verified field definition.
examples.count_transform: Identity; never apply the rate conversion to counts.
